en.headline: Sham Shui Po woman dies after melioidosis infection
en.dek: The 74-year-old with underlying illnesses was admitted with pneumonia and tested positive for the bacterium; the Centre for Health Protection says the case appears sporadic.
body: A 74-year-old woman from Sham Shui Po who had underlying illnesses has died after being diagnosed with melioidosis, the Centre for Health Protection said on Friday.

The centre said the patient developed fever and a cough with sputum from 4 October. She was admitted to Caritas Medical Centre on 7 October with shortness of breath and was diagnosed with pneumonia. Laboratory tests on clinical samples later confirmed Burkholderia pseudomallei, the bacterium that causes melioidosis. She died on 8 October and the cause of death is under investigation.

Preliminary epidemiological investigation indicates the case is sporadic and not linked to earlier confirmed cases in Hong Kong this year. The centre has recorded nine melioidosis cases so far in 2026, compared with 21 last year. It reminded high-risk groups, including the elderly and those with chronic illnesses, to avoid contact with soil or muddy water after typhoons or heavy rain.

zh.headline: 深水埗74歲女子感染類鼻疽後離世
zh.dek: 患者有長期病患，因肺炎入院後樣本對類鼻疽伯克氏菌呈陽性，防護中心指個案屬散發，正調查感染源頭。
body: 衞生防護中心周五公布，一名居於深水埗、有長期病患的74歲女子確診類鼻疽後離世。
中心表示，患者自本月4日起出現發燒及咳嗽帶痰，本月7日因氣促到明愛醫院急症室求醫，需留院治療，臨床診斷為肺炎。其臨床樣本經化驗證實對類鼻疽伯克氏菌呈陽性，病人於本月8日離世，死因仍在調查。
初步流行病學調查顯示個案屬散發，與本港早前其他確診個案沒有流行病學關連。本港今年至今錄得9宗類鼻疽個案，去年共21宗。中心提醒長者及長期病患者等高風險群組，在颱風或暴雨後應避免接觸土壤或泥水。
